newsitem.title: USA: FT70c tire sets Firestone new product records.
newsitem.headline: FT70c tire sets Firestone new product records.

text.p: In the three months following its April 1 introduction, the Firestone FT70c broke all new product sales records for Bridgestone/Firestone, the company said.
The Bridgestone Corp subsidiary said sales in the period were nearly double what it originally estimated.
"To say we are pleased is a dramatic understatement," said Shu Ishibashi, divisional vice president, Bridgestone/Firestone Consumer Tires Marketing.
"Through the end of June we sold more than 615,000 Firestone FT70c tires. Coupled with our July sales, we should reach the three-quarter million mark by mid-August."

Bridgestone/Firestone estimated first year sales for the new tire at 1.3 million units, or an average of 325,000 tires per quarter. Initially available in 19 sizes, the FT70c line expanded to 21 sizes in July when P215/60R16 and P225/60R16 sizes were added.
To continue marketplace momentum, Bridgestone/Firestone said, it is now implementing step two of its campaign to promote the Firestone FT70c.
Step one was the largest promotional effort for a single product undertaken by the company, it said.

"We are moving forward with efforts to increase the visibility of this product with consumers," Ishibashi said. "Step two includes new sales materials for dealers and a multi-medium advertising effort emphasizing that the FT70c was built to stop in the wet. A co-op ad program that includes information about the tire's UNI-T technologies is also part of step two."
